== Egwene Page ==

These aren't even my opinions, they're the actual info on the page that Zerah Dacan is deleting huge swathes of. I'm just trying to stop him from removing relevant and correct information. : Even if you didn't write it, it's clearly biased and without citations and that's the point. At this point, three different editors have been removing this material and you have been engaging in an edit war. It's not "actual info", it's material that should be removed because it's not meeting quality standards. That can exist on pages for a long while until it gets edited. It's also etiquette to engage with people on talk pages, create relevant sections for discussion and sign your replies. [[wikipedia:WP:NPOV|neutral point of view]] is one of the pillars of Wikipedia and a basic rule of article writing for factual content in general. If you want to support material in this way, write "character X thinks that Egwene is arrogant/reckless/manipulative" with information backed up by citations. Otherwise, it's completely fair game for deletion. I could equally write some paragraphs (without evidence) saying that Egwene is the best Amyrlin in the Tower's history and how she is persecuted and scapegoated by agents of the Black Ajah, that she is super intelligent, competent and the strongest in the character and in the Power in its history. == Matrim Cauthon ==

Mat's marriage is no spoiler. It has been prophecied since 4th book.[[User:Robin WH|Robin WH]] ([[User talk:Robin WH|talk]]) 03:00, 3 April 2021 (UTC)

: Hi, it's only a slight technicality that I made that change. Basically it's a general rule on wikis to try to not have spoilers from any of the books in the lede for the article as that appears in google searches. We are entirely open to spoilers in the content, but we want to avoid leaking too much by accident and it's a fairly easy fix to be able to do that as a courtesy. It was mentioned to me by the wiki manager as a general policy for fan wikis that I wouldn't have considered but makes sense in the bigger picture.

[[File:Screenshot 2021-04-04 085735.png|thumb]]

: The screenshot appears at the side and as the first entry in the google search for Matrim Cauthon. While it could be argued that the Daughter of Nine Moons has been mentioned since book 4, we don't know he will marry the Empress of Seanchan until we firstly find out what DotNM means and secondly that the Empress dies and Tuon becomes Fortuona, which doesn't happen until books 9 and 10. I am a little uncertain about how to determine what is best to include in the lede as spoilers, but I agree with it as a general policy. [[User:Moridin 2000|Moridin_2000]] ([[User talk:Moridin 2000|talk]]) 08:07, 4 April 2021 (UTC)

== ‎what ai art program do you use? ==

‎what ai art program do you use?

== what's up with the needless block? is that the most antisocial thing you could probably do? (new member contributed something he thought was good to the wot blog) ==

just wondering, no hard feelings

: Hi, I mentioned the reason for the temporary ban when it was issued. I don't have a problem with generative A.I., but you need to learn to use the tools effectively to match the characters as being book-accurate to a reasonable degree. As someone who has worked with generative art, you need to develop a work flow beyond text prompts which involves editing out undesirable artefacts and features. There are tools like ControlNet, img2img editing or digital editing that will help with that. I will give an example of a rejected image for reference:
 [[File:RejectedAIArt1.webp|thumb]]
: The image doesn't match any physical features of [[Shalon din Togara Morning Tide]], but here are a list of problems:

* She, and most of your other uploads, are white. Sea Folk are explicitly dark-skinned
* She has blue eyes
* She is missing the distinctive Sea Folk jewellery
* The text is both unnecessary and nonsense
* In that text, the name is wrong
* She has elf ears
* She a  large blue tattoo/decoration on her forehead

Note that your ban is only for file uploads. Since it is possible to generate many AI images in a relatively short time, I :insist on the quality being high in terms of book accuracy. There is some leeway for artistic licence, but within reason, and the tools exist to hold A.I. assisted art to a high standard.

[[User:Moridin 2000|Moridin_2000]] ([[User talk:Moridin 2000|talk]]) 08:44, 30 January 2024 (UTC)


Fair enough. This is reasonable enough. Perhaps somebody else who reads this will be able to get a good sense of what your expectations are for the blog and be able to better post artwork that matches your needs. 

It is possible that you may want to consider the descriptions on each character page: It is possible that for some characters, the text descriptions are not detailed or specific enough to meet your requirements.

Each of the images generated was generated using all relevant descriptive information found on the corresponding character page in the prompt.  It may be a good decision to ensure that no matter what, each character description is accurate and fully robust. That way, nobody else will make the same mistake I did.

Given your experience in generative art, I would love to see what you could do with generating images for each of the sea folk you decided to take down.

I hope you understand that it does not make sense for me to guess and risk wasting more energy.  I did just read all fourteen wheel of time books in a row since august with one of my best friends. It was his second time through the series and we each thought the set of generated images you took down was a nice addition to the empty array of sea folk portraits.  

Maybe you might agree to generate some better ones to replace the ones you took down? It sounds like they might be even better than the ones we made given your attention to detail and high standard.

🌿

== Hello Chris - Bot edits + bot tag + Adding Category:Redirects to all redirects ==

===Are you amiable with bot edits?===
Hiya, I've read through the policies here and I didn't see a rule against bot edits, but I figured I'd ask. Are you okay with bots edits on the Wiki? <br>
In case you don't know what those are, you can read about them on [[w:|Community Central]], [[w:Help:Bots|here]]. In short, its a program that can make many edits at once based on criteria.

===Would you be willing to give a bot tag?===
If you are okay with bot edits, would you be willing to tag my bot account, [[User:Moonwatcher x Qibli +bot+]], as a bot? This is so the bot edits don't flood [[Special:RecentChanges]]. You can read about bot tags on [[w:|Community Central]], [[w:Help:Bots#Bot flags|here]].

===Idea about [[:Category:Redirects]]===
I was wondering if you think it'd be a good idea to categorize all of our redirects in [[:Category:Redirects]]? They're all already categorized in subcategories like [[:Category:Geo-political redirects‎]] and [[:Category:Naming redirects]], and those categories are in Category:Redirects, but the individual pages are not.<br>
This might seem pointless, but honestly, it could be quite useful in the future. E.G.
* Widespread changes: If a widespread change needed to happen across all redirect articles having this category would make it so much easier for software like [[w:Help:AutoWikiBrowser|AWB]] (AutoWikiBrowser) or even Fandoms [[w:c:dev:MassEdit|ME]] (MassEdit) to enact the change.
* Redirect management: If you ever need to manage redirects in any way, having every one in a category page could be invaluble.
I do know that we have [[Special:Redirect]]s, but that doesn't work in the same way for AWB or ME.<br>

===Message Walls===
I was thinking, it might benefit the Wiki to modernize it a tad - mainly what I was thinking is enabling Fandom's [[w:Help:Message_Wall|Message Wall]] feature, which you can do [[Special:AdminDashboard|here]]. Of course TP's are good as well, it's just a thought I had - either way, TP's or MW's, is fine o course.

Anyways, thank you for taking the time to read this,<br>
